eva: quick sync on the DB outage follow-up. we need: clear owners, jira links, concise ACs. reply with Owner | AC | ETA | Jira. keep it short.

mike: i'll own the TTL edge-case fix. AC: TTL bug fixed + unit tests covering fanout case. ETA: 2026-04-07. ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-8100

dan: i'll take perf debugging + small benchmark in CI. AC: 99p latency within 2% or documented rollback. ETA: 2026-04-08. ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-8101

tara: i'll own the postmortem doc update and the owners table (include ISO dates). AC: doc updated with tickets & RACI. ETA: 2026-04-09. ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-8102

oncall-bot: Reminder: RDW-8100 assigned to mike is due in 3 days.

eva: please also add a small mitigation runbook item (one-line) that oncall can run. dan or mike can own.

mike: creating RDW-8103 for "hotfix + runbook". owner: mike. AC: rollback command + playbook step validated on staging. ETA: 2026-04-06. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-8103

dan: i'll add a perf smoke check to the canary job and link it in RDW-8101.

tara: adding an "Owners" table entry in the doc now with RACI: mike(R), eva(A), dan(C), oncall-bot(I). setting due dates.

eva: ok --- final checklist to include in each ticket PR description:

```
- [ ] fix merged
- [ ] unit + regression tests
- [ ] perf smoke attached
- [ ] canary plan + rollback thresholds
- [ ] postmortem doc updated
```

oncall-bot: Note: RDW-8103 (mike) set to high priority by eva.

mike: PR opened for RDW-8100, adding checklist and linking RDW-8103. tagging @dan for perf review.

dan: will review PR today and run the bench suite.

tara: once all tickets are linked, i'll schedule a quick verification slot in planning and close the action items.

eva: thanks everyone. i'll paste this thread into the postmortem actions and mark as closed after verification. escalate in #postmortems if anything slips. :wave:
